title: Where the project stands
text: Retinue is early and public. The framework repository is open, the first deployment runs daily against real data, and the documentation is roughly half of what a stranger would need to stand up their own instance. This week is mostly writing: a quickstart that gets a fresh deployment to a first answer, and a worked example of the chamber plugin layout. Two open questions from outside the project are waiting for an answer, and the licence choice is still undecided — that one blocks the packaging work behind it.
